For professional enquiries, collaboration on actuarial analysis, or questions
about the research on this site, send a message below. It goes directly to my
inbox and I will reply by email.

```{=html}
<form class="contact-form" id="contact-form"
      action="https://formsubmit.co/ea4a86c8593343c2c78e6a100e14c2c5" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New message from ntandosithole.com">
  <input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">
  <input type="hidden" name="_next" value="https://ntandosithole.com/contact.html?sent=1">
  <input type="text" name="_honey" class="contact-honeypot" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true">

  <div class="contact-row">
    <div class="contact-field">
      <label for="contact-name" class="form-label">Name</label>
      <input type="text" id="contact-name" name="name" class="form-control" autocomplete="name" required maxlength="120">
    </div>
    <div class="contact-field">
      <label for="contact-email" class="form-label">Email</label>
      <input type="email" id="contact-email" name="email" class="form-control" autocomplete="email" required maxlength="200">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="contact-field">
    <label for="contact-topic" class="form-label">Subject</label>
    <input type="text" id="contact-topic" name="topic" class="form-control" maxlength="200">
  </div>
  <div class="contact-field">
    <label for="contact-message" class="form-label">Message</label>
    <textarea id="contact-message" name="message" class="form-control" rows="7" required maxlength="5000"></textarea>
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send message</button>
  <p class="contact-status" id="contact-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>

<p class="contact-alt">
  You can also reach me on
  <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ntandwenhle-sithole-b06896169/">LinkedIn</a>.
</p>

<script>
(function () {
  var form = document.getElementById("contact-form");
  var status = document.getElementById("contact-status");
  if (!form || !window.fetch) return;
  if (/[?&]sent=1/.test(window.location.search)) {
    status.textContent = "Thank you. Your message has been sent.";
    status.className = "contact-status is-success";
  }
  form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    var button = form.querySelector("button[type=submit]");
    button.disabled = true;
    status.textContent = "Sending...";
    status.className = "contact-status";
    fetch(form.action.replace("formsubmit.co/", "formsubmit.co/ajax/"), {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Accept": "application/json" },
      body: new FormData(form)
    })
      .then(function (response) {
        return response.json().then(function (data) {
          if (!response.ok || String(data.success) !== "true") throw new Error(data.message || "Send failed");
        });
      })
      .then(function () {
        form.reset();
        status.textContent = "Thank you. Your message has been sent.";
        status.className = "contact-status is-success";
      })
      .catch(function () {
        status.innerHTML = 'Sorry, the message could not be sent. Please try again shortly or message me on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ntandwenhle-sithole-b06896169/">LinkedIn</a>.';
        status.className = "contact-status is-error";
      })
      .then(function () { button.disabled = false; });
  });
})();
</script>
```
